synergisticSpecs.description: config_update_tool validates tool infrastructure, hierarchical-activity-composition validates usage pattern. Both specifications complement each other.

mcp-hot-reload ensures MCP.reload() works, hierarchical-activity-composition ensures config_update triggers it automatically. Dependency: mcp-hot-reload → config_update_tool → hierarchical-activity-composition

Learning loop provides success rate metrics for composition decisions (60% threshold). Compose-first paradigm feeds execution data back to learning loop. Backend-only architecture ensures consistent template availability for both specs.

requirements.hierarchical-activity-composition: Must reject local storage, force MCP registration, retry logic with exponential backoff
requirements.activity-recommendation-learning: Must persist to backend for learning loop, cache management

sharedComponents.recommendation: Current implementation satisfies both specs. Retry logic added by hierarchical-activity-composition improves reliability for learning loop.

requirements.hierarchical-activity-composition: createImpulse parameter for activity reuse, no CLI usage in agents
requirements.config_update_tool: All parameters exist with correct types, MCP.reload integration

sharedComponents.recommendation: Consider merging validation tests to avoid duplication. Current implementation satisfies both specs.

improvements.impact: Prevents crashes on complex activity state

improvements.impact: Improves resilience to malformed LLM output
